card.fires_on: The decimal point (or a following zero) right after "<0" in small percentages like "<0.1%", mostly in adverse-reaction rates. Also the 0 in p-values such as "p < 0.01".

card.writes: It pushes toward a following digit rather than spelled-out number words like thirty or fifty.
card.plain: It marks the point in a tiny percentage such as "less than 0.1%" where the next digit is expected.
